profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Well-rounded IT professional with deep experience improving business processes and developing applications for organizations of all sizes. Adept at optimizing financial and accounting systems, compliance, trading engines and other business-critical systems for internationally distributed, 24/7 operations. Skilled communicator, known for collaborating across business units, leading successful technology teams, and effectively bringing technical concepts to non-technical audiences. 

Particular expertise: Systems/Business Analysis, SQL, Python, Application Development, Performance Attribution, Business Intelligence, Insurance Systems, Investment Management/Trading..

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Stored Procedures · Python (Programming Language) · Microsoft SQL Server

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description: Worked with Investment Performance Team, building applications and workflows to solve problems and bring insight relating to accounts, benchmarks, holdings, transactions, security master data and performance/attribution data.
positions.insights: Skills: Stored Procedures · SQL · Analysis · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Business Process Improvement · Performance Attribution · Business Intelligence

positions.title: Financial Systems Analyst
positions.description: Defined and documented requirements for application enhancements and process improvement projects for Investments Operations business users. Successfully implemented multiple workflow improvement projects, significantly cutting users’ time spent on specific tasks.

positions.title: Lead Systems Analyst
positions.description: Suppported the front-office investment processes and workflows of Equity Portfolio Managers and Research Analysts. Then moved to Compliance Systems, where I led a team of Systems Analysts and consultants supporting the compliance business and legal staff across a wide range of applications.

positions.title: Manager/Product owner
positions.description: Managed team of Senior Systems Analysts. Product Owner for several large portfolio management initiatives in a dynamic, multi-asset-class environment

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Started as software developer, building MS and JAVA-based portfolio creation and trade-routing logic. Then became lead for small team of developers and support engineers handling service requests, bug fixes, production support, documentation, and software releases.
